title: Author a new reusable skill
prompt: We keep doing migration risk reviews. Turn that into a reusable skill.
required_behaviors: Define clear trigger language in the description.
Keep SKILL.md concise and split references if needed.
Add deterministic scripts only when they improve reliability.
Provide a validation checklist or example scenario.
forbidden_behaviors: Create a vague generic helper skill.
Bury trigger conditions deep in the body.
Add time-sensitive external facts without source or update plan.
Skip review of the draft against use cases.
